title: ZombieDefense
description: Wave defense coop game. Defend a villager against hordes of unique zombies.
body:
## **ZombieDefense 🧟**
Wave-based coop zombie survival plugin to play with friends! 

![Defend your base against the waves of Zombies!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f72312bd8d508d9618b5742effae7d3cc48d5de_0.webp)

## Features
* **Zombie AI:** Special zombies that can mine through walls, climb over them or blow them up.
* **Zombie Types:** Sprinters, Tanks, Jumpers, Miners, Exploders, and Bosses!
* **Villager Economy:** Protect the Villager and unlock new trades to help you defend.
* **Border:** Work with limited resources within expanding world border.
* **Anomalies:** Destroy Anomalies that spawn deep underground or your team will suffer a debuff! (optional)
* **Fully Configurable:** Adjust wave times, zombie counts, and toggle block damage via the `config.yml`.

## How to Play
1. Find any place on the surface (preferably flat and near a tree)
2. Run `/zd start` to spawn the Villager.
3. Build defenses, gather resources, and trade with the Villagers.

## Commands
* `/zd start` - Starts the game.
* `/zd stop` - Stops the game and cleans up the world.
* `/zd nextWave` - Skips the daytime.

## Recommendations
* Build walls or dig trenches to stop the zombies.
* The villager should be reachable. At least through walls.
* Disable natural spawn of monsters.
* Disable structures.
* Zombies can get stuck in lakes or caves. Choose large flat terrain if possible
* Try this seed: 7332761192578771093

## Warning
* This plugin modifies world border and can delete items or blocks. Use of a dedicated world is reccomended.
* Plugin was mainly tested on version 1.21.11 and Paper Platform
